purpose: Review criteria for generic documents: lists the delegated SSOT documents, check order, and rules for choosing fix, create_issue or skip.
summary: Delegates severity and gray-zone judgment to principles documents; holds no judgment itself
P1 SSOT table: document style guide, project document rules, error classification spec
P2 contradiction check such as term mismatch and duplication
P3 unnecessary complexity check via spec priorities spec
Check order: style, project rules, error handling, contradiction, complexity
Error handling check: swallowed errors, judgeable events, per-cause values
Fallback to built-in style guide when project rules are missing
tasks: Building a review packet for document review
Checking documents against the style guide
Checking error handling descriptions in documents
title: generic レビュー基準
